body_html:
@jeffjarvis when I went to the AWS public sector meeting the CIA CTO was the keynote speaker.

He described how CIA was moving from using their own servers to AWS.

Amazon has cameras in many dpors and now wants eyes in the sky.

CIA doesn't have a shady past at all....
